items.t: ChargePoint and Kässbohrer Accelerate Electrification Across Europe and North America to Create Zero Emission Ski Resorts
items.sum: CAMPBELL, Calif., November 24, 2026--ChargePoint (NYSE: CHPT), a global leader in intelligent electrification and e-mobility, today announced a strategic partnership with Kässbohrer Geländefahrzeug AG, manufacturer of the world-leading PistenBully snow groomers, to support ski resorts across Europe and North America on their path toward electrification.

items.t: ChargePoint Forms Strategic Partnership With Kässbohrer To Bring Charging Solutions To Ski Resorts Across Europe And North America
items.sum: New agreement gives Kässbohrer customers access to ChargePoint charging solutions for electric snow groomers, fleets, facilities, and visitor EVsSki resorts can work with a single trusted partner to electrify operations
